property_summary: For any caller and arrays of recipients and values (with matching non-empty lengths), C.transfer always returns true (does not revert) when its external calls to caddress succeed; the mutant inverts the success check and can return false for those same successful external calls, so there exists an adversarial callee whose successful behavior makes the mutant return false while the reference still returns true.
change_summary: Invert the success check of the external call so the function returns true only if the internal call failed (without reverting).
